messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary rollout (canary-streaming v2) - 10% traffic - 5xx rate > 6% in last 2m. Pager sent to eng-oncall.

maria: seeing it now, 5xx mostly 503/504 from inference workers. rolling canary to 10% at 10:12 UTC

jon: logs from edge:
```
[2026-03-11T10:12:18Z] stream.req id=abc123 status=503 backend=grpc-infer-7 msg="KV cache miss + OOM retry"
[2026-03-11T10:12:19Z] stream.req id=def456 status=504 backend=grpc-infer-8 msg="upstream timeout"
```

sam: looks like the new batching kernel is causing degraded tail latency -> retries pile up. Repro locally with seq_len 2048, qbatch enabled.

maria: can we flip the rollout flag? if kill-switch exists, do it and abort traffic shift.

sam: yes flip `feature.canary_streaming` to false in LaunchDarkly. ops runbook says that will roll traffic back to stable variant.

maria: /runbook flip-flag feature.canary_streaming false -> done

deploy-bot: Flag update: feature.canary_streaming set to false by maria at 10:15 UTC :white_check_mark:

maria: aborting canary rollout, initiating rollback to model v1-stable. Triggering immediate 90% traffic re-route away from canary nodes.

carol: initiating rollback via orchestration: `deploy rollback --target model-service --to v1-stable --reason "canary 5xx spike"`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for model-service to v1-stable (id=rollback-20260311-1016). Expected completion ~3m.

olivia: support check - any customer-facing errors? are embedding/api endpoints affected or only streaming?

maria: impact: streaming path (realtime websocket/stream) had ~6% of requests 5xx during canary window. Embeddings and blocking gen unaffected. No major customer outages reported yet, a few retries from partners. We'll send P0 if error rate persists after rollback.

sam: posting more logs and a short trace for postmortem:
```
trace-id: 0f1e2d -> batcher queue growth @ 200ms, kernel stall -> upstream 503
```

maria: removing canary nodes from LB pool now. Monitoring metrics: 5xx rate trending down after rollback start :arrow_down_small:

jon: noted that kernel module `qbatch_v2` introduces a path that mis-handled certain pad tokens at seq=0 -> patch incoming. Marking for rollback hotfix.

maria: handoff to eve (next oncall) - summary below:
- incident: canary streaming v2 caused elevated 5xx (~6%) at 10:12 UTC
- mitigation: flipped `feature.canary_streaming` -> false, rollback to v1-stable started.
- customer impact: limited to streaming route, no broad API outage.
- follow-ups: disable qbatch_v2 in candidate builds, add canary healthcheck gating for KV-cache/memory metrics.

eve: ack, taking over monitoring and postmortem. I'll watch for any regression and kick off a postmortem doc if we see >1% 5xx in 30m. Thanks.

maria: TY, will update #status once rollback completes and metrics stabilize.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 10:19 UTC :white_check_mark:

maria: metrics looking better, 5xx back to baseline (~0.3%). closing active pager but keeping a watch for 30m. :eyes:

eve: will run the canary replay test and schedule a postmortem sync at 15:00 UTC.

incident-bot: Pager closed by maria. Duration 7m. Tags: canary, rollback, kill-switch.
